mapper.sql: r.id, r.project_id, r.workflow_id, r.title, r.description, r.creator_id, r.status, r.current_seq, r.dsh_workspace_path, r.revision, r.created_at, r.updated_at, w.name AS workflow_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_requirement_node n WHERE n.requirement_id = r.id) AS node_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_requirement_node n WHERE n.requirement_id = r.id AND n.status = 'done') AS done_node_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wb_requirement r LEFT JOIN wb_workflow w ON w.id = r.workflow_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_requirement (project_id, workflow_id, title, description, creator_id, status, current_seq, dsh_workspace_path, revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{workflowId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{creatorId}, #{status}, #{currentSeq}, #{dshWorkspacePath}, #{revision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO wb_requirement_node (requirement_id, workflow_node_id, seq, name, description, input_type, inputs_snapshot, outputs_snapshot, skills_snapshot, primary_session_id, status, started_at, completed_at, completed_by, created_at) VALUES
(#{node.requirementId}, #{node.workflowNodeId}, #{node.seq}, #{node.name}, #{node.description}, #{node.inputType}, #{node.inputsSnapshot}, #{node.outputsSnapshot}, #{node.skillsSnapshot}, #{node.primarySessionId}, #{node.status}, #{node.startedAt}, #{node.completedAt}, #{node.completedBy}, #{node.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, requirement_id, workflow_node_id, seq, name, description, input_type, inputs_snapshot, outputs_snapshot, skills_snapshot, primary_session_id, status, started_at, completed_at, completed_by, created_at FROM wb_requirement_node WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId} ORDER BY seq ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE wb_requirement_node SET primary_session_id = NULL WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId} AND primary_session_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE i FROM wb_session_runtime_info i JOIN wb_agent_session s ON s.id = i.agent_session_id WHERE s.requirement_id = #{requirementId}
DELETE l FROM wb_node_session_link l JOIN wb_requirement_node n ON n.id = l.node_instance_id WHERE n.requirement_id = #{requirementId}
